activate.description: Bring App Store to the foreground without selecting content or starting an account, download, or purchase flow.

open-today.description: Select the exact Today tab and stop before selecting content or operating account, download, or purchase controls.

open-games.description: Select the exact Games tab and stop before selecting content or operating account, download, or purchase controls.

open-apps.description: Select the exact Apps tab and stop before selecting content or operating account, download, or purchase controls.

open-arcade.description: Select the exact Arcade tab and stop before selecting content or operating account, download, or purchase controls.

open-search.description: Select the exact Search tab and stop before selecting content or operating account, download, or purchase controls.

foreground-only.description: Foreground App Store without selecting content.

navigate-today.description: Foreground App Store and select only the Today tab.

navigate-games.description: Foreground App Store and select only the Games tab.

navigate-apps.description: Foreground App Store and select only the Apps tab.

navigate-arcade.description: Foreground App Store and select only the Arcade tab.

navigate-search.description: Foreground App Store and select only the Search tab.

prohibited: selecting or inspecting an app, game, story, event, offer, subscription, search result, or account item
entering a search query or enumerating store, recommendation, account, update, or result content
getting, buying, downloading, updating, deleting, rating, reviewing, sharing, subscribing to, or restoring an item
opening account, payment, purchase-history, subscription, redemption, or family controls
safety.uncertain_outcome: A tab tap may already have changed the visible destination. Inspect only the exact destination-tab accessibility identifier before deciding; never select content or replay blindly.

host: Appium/XCUITest only for declared navigation controls
permissions: locally signed WebDriverAgent only for UI navigation

data_access: visible App Store destination-tab control state only
privacy.retention: The integration stores no store content, query, app, account, purchase, subscription, or payment data.
privacy.notes: The manifest exposes foregrounding and exact top-level destination tabs only. Search entry, content selection, account flows, downloads, updates, and purchases are unsupported.
